attackers_goals: To ensure they have persistence on the system, the threat actor may use scheduled tasks to set persistence, Then, to avoid detection and carry out stealth execution, they may inject a malicious payload into a remote process.
description: An unsigned process created scheduled task and performed an injection.
investigative_actions: Investigate the injection payload and the injection process. Check if the scheduled task trigger payload is malicious.
name: An unsigned process created scheduled task and performed an injection
